title: An MCP instance in the shared registry
description: One owner-only JSON file per running instance in $PRISMATIC_MCP_REGISTRY (default ~/.local/state/prismatic-mcp/instances). Written by the instance itself when its MCP server starts (src/prismatic_mcp/prismatic_mcp_registry.cpp) or by a control panel for itself; removed on stop. A reader drops a record whose owner_pid is no longer alive. The token is never in the record, only the path of its 0600 file.

name.description: Unique in the registry; also the file name without .json

kind.description: server: a headless dedicated server; gui: a process with an interface, written by the process itself (its live role, network client, host or single player, is in its own openttd://game/state); client: a GUI client as recorded by the panel that attached it; panel: a control panel

owner_pid.description: The process that owns the record; the record is stale when it is gone

endpoint.description: The MCP endpoint (JSON-RPC over HTTP, bearer token)

token_file.description: Path of the 0600 file {agent_token, endpoint}; absent when none was written

game_port.description: A dedicated server's game port; null for a GUI process
